summary: A GNOME Discourse forum thread where a user asks how to get the full path of a file selected in a GTK4 C file chooser dialog, since gtk_file_chooser_get_current_name asserts when used in OPEN mode and crashes the app. Another user suggests gtk_file_chooser_get_filename, and a link is shared to a GTK3-oriented guide, which the user notes does not fit GTK4. The user eventually solves it by using gtk_file_chooser_get_file and g_file_get_path in the response handler, then the topic was auto-closed after 30 days of inactivity.
one_line: Forum thread on retrieving the full path of a file chosen in a GTK4 C file chooser dialog, solved with gtk_file_chooser_get_file and g_file_get_path.
key_facts: The user's crash message was a Gtk-CRITICAL assertion in gtk_file_chooser_widget_get_current_name stating impl->action == GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_SAVE failed.
The user's program then terminated with std::logic_error and the message basic_string::_M_construct null not valid.
The user's dialog was created with the action GTK_FILE_CHOOSER_ACTION_OPEN and the response handler was on_open_response.
The user's original code used gtk_file_chooser_get_current_name, which is intended for save dialogs.
gusnan (Andreas Rönnquist) suggested using gtk_file_chooser_get_filename on the dialog in the on_open_response function, noting he had not tested it.
gusnan noted that the referenced code reacted to GTK_RESPONSE_OK rather than GTK_RESPONSE_ACCEPT, so behavior might differ.
Stefan Salewski pointed to his guide at ssalewski.de/gtkprogramming.html#_filechooserdialog for getting the full name and path.
The user replied that Salewski's solution was probably from GTK3 and that they needed GTK4.
Emmanuele Bassi suggested the 'Getting Started' tutorial on developer.gnome.org, which has a section on opening a file and reading its contents.
The user's final solution used g_autoptr (GFile) file = gtk_file_chooser_get_file(GTK_FILE_CHOOSER(dialog)).
The user's final solution converted the path with g_file_get_path(file) and stored it in a std::string.
The user's final solution displayed the resulting path by calling gtk_label_set_text on the label.
The topic was automatically closed on December 3, 2022, 30 days after the last reply.
